Setup.Name: Convert °C in °F
Setup.Description: Converts a value from °C in °F using the expression syntax.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Converts a value from °C to °F."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/temperature"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          Instrument: Gauge
          Value: "(PAYLOAD()* 1.8) + 32.0"
